title: Orka.ai Groq live SQL evaluation
note: Gold SQL is executed locally to calculate expected results. Cases are grouped by evaluation focus; categories are not isolated model capabilities.

cases.question: How many customers are in the customer database?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

cases.question: Count customers whose country is India.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'India';

cases.question: How many customers live in the United Kingdom?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'UK';

cases.question: Show every customer name in alphabetical order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: List the names of customers located in Germany.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany' ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: How many customers signed up after March 1, 2025?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date > DATE '2025-03-01';

cases.question: How many products are listed?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products;

cases.question: List the products in the Electronics category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY product_name;

cases.question: Which product has the highest price? Return its name and price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_name LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Find the least expensive product and its price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC, product_name LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Count all orders with Completed status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed';

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled';

cases.question: Count orders placed during June 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-06-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-07-01';

cases.question: Show the order IDs and dates for completed orders, oldest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: How many customers signed up during May 2025?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2025-05-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-06-01';

cases.question: Count customers in each country.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY country;

cases.question: Show the number of products in each category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;

cases.question: What is the average price of all products?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products;

cases.question: List products costing more than 100, most expensive first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100 ORDER BY price DESC, product_name;

cases.question: For every order, show its ID, customer name, and status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: How many completed orders were placed by customers from India?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND c.country = 'India';

cases.question: Show each customer's name and number of orders, including customers with no orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Calculate total revenue from all order items using quantity multiplied by product price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;

cases.question: Calculate revenue from completed orders only.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Calculate revenue from cancelled orders only.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Cancelled';

cases.question: How many units were purchased across all order items, regardless of order status?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items;

cases.question: How many units were included in completed orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS completed_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show revenue by product name, highest revenue first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.product_name;

cases.question: Show total revenue for each product category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

cases.question: Count orders by their status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

cases.question: What is the average order value for completed orders? Use completed revenue divided by the number of completed orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show the total completed-order spend for each customer.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS completed_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY completed_spend DESC, c.customer_name;

cases.question: How many units of each product have been ordered?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name;

cases.question: Which two products generated the most revenue?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 2;

cases.question: How many distinct customers have placed completed orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show completed order counts for each customer country.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;

cases.question: Which customer placed the greatest number of orders? Return the customer name and order count.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 1;

cases.question: What is the earliest order date?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest_order_date FROM orders;

cases.question: What is the most recent order date?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(order_date) AS latest_order_date FROM orders;

cases.question: Count completed orders placed on or after June 10, 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-06-10';

cases.question: What is the average quantity per order-item record?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity FROM order_items;

cases.question: For each country, show the number of completed orders and completed revenue.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS completed_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;

cases.question: Which products have never appeared in an order item?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.product_name;

cases.question: List customer names and countries for customers from India or the UK.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, country FROM customers WHERE country IN ('India', 'UK') ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: Show completed orders with the customer name and order date, sorted newest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id;

cases.question: Calculate the number of completed orders per month in 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) ORDER BY order_month;

cases.question: Show the total quantity sold for each product category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

cases.question: Find customers who have at least one cancelled order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Cancelled' ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Calculate the total value of all completed orders for each order ID.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: Show the top three customers by number of completed orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 3;
